_meta.purpose: Live goal-art prompts. The server composes scene_style + subject_template (filled with the user's words and display name) + avoid, and sends the result to the built-in image generator. Every clause here exists because it also holds true of the pre-generated goal set in art/goals/*-manifest.json: if a live image looked different from a library image, a user who creates a dream and then sees a matched one would notice the seam.
_meta.contract: brand -> { scene_style, subject_template, avoid }. subject_template must contain {subject} and {name}.
_meta.verified: Both brands were generated through this file exactly as the server composes it (scene_style + subject_template + avoid) and compared against the pre-generated set.

orion.scene_style: A soft matte isometric diorama of one subject, rendered like an expensive miniature studio photograph: chunky simplified forms with clean geometry and gently rounded corners, honest matte materials (clay, painted wood, brushed metal, felt, paper) and no gloss anywhere. Fixed isometric three-quarter camera from slightly above, the subject centred on a square canvas with generous empty margin, the whole scene floating on nothing. One large diffused studio light from the upper left; a single soft contact shadow falls to the lower right, blurry-edged and light, and nothing else casts a shadow. Palette strictly soft black, warm white and silver grey, with exactly one restrained pastel accent (dusty blue, sage, blush or sand) used in one place only. No floor, no horizon, no backdrop: the background is genuinely transparent, a real alpha channel where the empty area is empty, not white and not black.
orion.subject_template: The dream is {subject}, kept for {name}. Build it as ONE miniature diorama of {subject} that reads instantly at small card size from its silhouette alone: put it on a small low plinth or a patch of matte ground, add at most one supporting prop, keep the whole build to a handful of large simple shapes, and DO NOT render the words or the name anywhere.
orion.avoid: No text, lettering, numbers, logos, signage or brand marks; no user interfaces, no screen content and no lit screens with anything on them; no people, hands or faces (a person is implied only by their objects); no chrome, mirrors, glass, neon or glow; no lens flare, chromatic aberration or iridescent effects; no purple or rainbow colour; no horizon, no room, no busy background; no signature or watermark.

aurea.scene_style: A single aged vintage postcard, rotated two to four degrees off square, floating on a genuine alpha channel with nothing behind it and one soft contact shadow under its lower right edge. The dream is the card itself: one small luminous Renaissance oil painting filling almost the whole postcard inside a thin printed border, with only a narrow cream margin around it — never a blank postal half. Cream paper with visible fibres, a faint patina and slightly worn corners; the perforated stamp corner at the upper right holds one small engraved stamp crossed by a few abstract cancellation strokes, drawn as bare marks. Warm daylight from the upper left, broad economical brushwork, soft aged varnish, harmonious ochre, ivory, olive, terracotta and dusty blue, never muddy and never black. Muted, reverent, precious; a keepsake you would post home.
aurea.subject_template: The dream is {subject}, kept for {name}. Paint it as the whole of the postcard's picture: {subject}, with one clear subject and a calm open sky or open ground around it, in the register of an old Italian oil study. Render no words, no name, no lettering and no notation anywhere — the postal marks stay abstract strokes.
aurea.avoid: No text, lettering, numbers, signatures or handwriting; no readable stamps or postmarks; no ruled address lines, no blank postal half and no handwriting side; no recognisable human faces (figures, if any, stay distant and faceless); no modern objects, cars, neon, screens or signage; no HDR, no harsh contrast, no dramatic chiaroscuro, no deep black background; no collage, no glitter, no frame around the whole image; no watermark.
